A folder-level pathspec to safe-commit reached an IGNORED provider binary. `git rm -r <folder>` plus the folder as the pathspec staged infra/aws/terraform/canonical-schwab-si2-schedule/.terraform/providers/.../terraform-provider-aws_v5.100.0_x5.exe, and the commit-gate's large-file limb refused it -- correctly, since the only remedy after the fact is a history rewrite of a shared branch. `.terraform/` IS gitignored at infra/aws/terraform/.gitignore:1, so the ignore was bypassed somewhere in the staging path. Retiring any Terraform root after an init will hit this; the safe form is file-level pathspecs of the tracked files, which is what landed here.

The order was cut without <proof_genre>DEPLOY</proof_genre>, which no seat but the issuer may add -- the checker's whole point is that the genre is the issuer's mark, not the applier's claim. dd-4 hit this exact gap in round 80 and closed it with a one-line amendment. Worth adding to the LGIC_BLANKFIX cut template, since every CloudOps order under it will need the marker to produce a valid instance.
